top_signals.title: CISA warns of hackers exploiting Langflow, N-central, Apache Tomcat flaws
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency is giving federal agencies three days to mitigate vulnerabilities in IBM Langflow, N-central, and Apache Tomcat, all actively exploited. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Federal crackdown leads to arrest of 86 truck drivers, 766 out-of-service orders
top_signals.summary:
A three-day federal operation led to the arrest of 86 truck drivers, 766 out-of-service orders and 51 immigrant detentions.

The post Federal crackdown leads to arrest of 86 truck drivers, 766 out-of-service orders appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Canadian pleads guilty to Snowflake cloud data-theft attacks
top_signals.summary: A Canadian man pleaded guilty today to his role in accessing company accounts at cloud storage provider Snowflake and stealing data from at least 165 organizations in a scheme to extort millions of dollars from victims. [...]
